test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Ramesh visits his hometown quite______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**frequently**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**frequently**'.
 
• It means 'regularly or habitually; often'. (बार-बार)
 
 
• *Example: I went there **frequently** to observe their habits.*
 
 
 
• The word 'quite' qualifies the adverb &
